original_direct_foundation_path.reason: the archived direct OpenMind path is strict-lane evidence and does not persist row-aligned conditional OOF predictions

decision.promotion_rule: at least 1% pooled development RMSE gain vs PyKrige, better than no-foundation structural control, and wins >=80% of fold-seed cells

fixed_protocol.gate_model: inner-OOF LogisticRegression benefit probability times train-only selected bounded scale

openmind_feature_audit.input_projection: per-patch active-cell zscore then fixed mean of 3 seismic channels
openmind_feature_audit.spatial_sampling: trilinear voxel-centre sampling from all encoder stages

pykrige_oof_sources.training_use: base predictions are OOF before residual stacking
